author: kltm
body:
Reported by @raymond91125 in #6411 (comment): https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/issues/6411#issuecomment-4422524190

The two issue-triggered GitHub Actions workflows — `report-direct-ann-term.yml` and `report-regulates-ann-term.yml` — have been failing since around 2026-05-08. Both invoke `scripts/annotation-review-report.py`, which fetches CSV-format annotation exports from GOlr.

## Symptom

The script fails on the first GOlr request with:

```
Exception: HTTP error status code: 429 for url: http://golr-aux.geneontology.io/solr/select?...&wt=csv&rows=100000&start=0&fl=...
```

Example failed run (triggered from issue #6415, same workflow):
https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/actions/runs/25698397744

## Cause

A GO-side rate-limit rule covering bulk CSV exports against GOlr was tightened last week to stem an unrelated traffic problem. It throttles requests of shape `(host = golr/golr-aux) + (path = /solr/select) + (wt=csv) + (rows=100000)`. GitHub-hosted runners share an Azure IP pool with many other tenants, and the workflow makes back-to-back requests with no client-side rate-limit, so it trips the rule almost immediately.

## Fix

Two-part:

1. **This repo:** PR #6417 — set a stable, identifiable `User-Agent` header (`geneontology-go-annotation-action/1.0 (+https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation)`) on the script's requests.
2. **GO ops side (applied):** narrow allowlist clause added to the blocking rate-limit rule so traffic carrying that User-Agent isn't throttled. (A second, log-only rule covering `rows=100000 + python` UA is being kept as-is for observability — filtered out after the fact.)

Script request shape and volume are unchanged. Workflow should pass again once #6417 is merged.
